# IGIER - Innocenzo Gasparini Institute for Economic Research

> IGIER is a leading international economics research institute at Bocconi University conducting cutting-edge research in macroeconomics, political economy, labor markets, and economic policy.

IGIER is an independent research center within Bocconi University in Milan, Italy, hosting faculty researchers, visiting scholars, and fellows who collaborate on funded research projects and publish in top economics venues. The institute organizes seminars, conferences, and policy workshops while offering opportunities for graduate students and research assistants to participate in active research initiatives.

## About IGIER

- [IGIER - Innocenzo Gasparini Institute for Economic Research](https://igier.unibocconi.eu): IGIER homepage: international economics research institute at Bocconi University

- [35 Years of Research and Vision From Past to Future](https://igier.unibocconi.eu/about/35-years-research-and-vision-past-future): IGIER 35-year anniversary celebrating research excellence and institutional vision
- [Contact Us](https://igier.unibocconi.eu/about/contact-us): IGIER contact information, staff directory, office location in Milano

## Research Areas & Projects

- [Research Clusters](https://igier.unibocconi.eu/research/research-clusters): IGIER research clusters: cognitive economics, AI, sustainability, future of work
- [Ongoing Projects](https://igier.unibocconi.eu/research/ongoing-projects): Active IGIER research projects in macroeconomics, labor, development, policy
- [Working Papers](https://igier.unibocconi.eu/research/working-papers): IGIER working papers series in economic theory, game theory, political economy
- [Datasets](https://igier.unibocconi.eu/research/datasets): IGIER research datasets on political economy, fiscal policy, electoral systems
